premise: Owl falls asleep on his branch one sunny morning while Bird sings and Squirrel crunches right beneath him; they find out why he sleeps all day, go quiet, and that night Owl wakes and hoots them a thank-you.
inspiration: The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse (Aesop), turned: two ways of living share one tree, and understanding replaces judging.
lesson: Friends can live by different clocks and still look after each other.
learning: Owls sleep in the day and wake up at night

en-US.title: Owl Sleeps All Day
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.8 40s} It was a bright, sunny morning. {owl:enter} Owl flew down onto his favourite branch, home from a long night. {owl:live hold} He blinked, looked around, gave a great big yawn… and fell fast asleep. {bird:enter} Along flew Bird, to the branch next door. {bird:face happy} [excited] Good morning! {bird:live} He puffed up his chest, tipped back his head and sang his loudest song. {sfx:tweet} Tweet-tweet-TWEET! {squirrel:enter} Squirrel bounded over with her hazelnut, right under Owl's tree. {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:live} She nibbled it, CRUNCH, CRUNCH. She looked left… and right… and hid it behind her back, very innocent… then hugged it. {bird:pulse} [curious] Why is Owl always asleep? asked Bird. {squirrel:face normal} [whispers] He's awake all night, said Squirrel, flying under the stars. {bird:face surprised} {bird:tint #FFB3C6} Oh! So Bird sang his quietest song, tweet… and Squirrel {squirrel:shake 0.5} tiptoed. {canvas:night 0.7 20s} [softly] That night, under the moon, {bird:face sleeping} {squirrel:face sleeping} they were tucked up in bed when {owl:live resume} Owl opened one eye… then both, and hooted a soft thank-you. {sfx:hoo} Hoo-hoo.

es-ES.title: Búho duerme todo el día
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.8 40s} Era una mañana de sol radiante. {owl:enter} Búho bajó volando hasta su rama favorita, tras una larga noche. {owl:live hold} Parpadeó, miró a su alrededor, bostezó… y se quedó frito. {bird:enter} Llegó volando Pájaro, a la rama de al lado. {bird:face happy} [excited] ¡Buenos días! {bird:live} Hinchó el pecho, echó la cabeza atrás y cantó su canción más fuerte. {sfx:tweet} ¡Pío-pío-PÍO! {squirrel:enter} Ardilla llegó brincando con su avellana, bajo el árbol de Búho. {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:live} La mordisqueó, CRAC, CRAC. Miró a la izquierda… a la derecha… la escondió detrás de la espalda, muy inocente… y luego la abrazó. {bird:pulse} [curious] ¿Por qué Búho siempre duerme?, preguntó Pájaro. {squirrel:face normal} [whispers] Está despierto toda la noche, dijo Ardilla, volando bajo las estrellas. {bird:face surprised} {bird:tint #FFB3C6} ¡Oh! Así que Pájaro cantó bajito, pío… y Ardilla {squirrel:shake 0.5} anduvo de puntillas. {canvas:night 0.7 20s} [softly] Esa noche, bajo la luna, {bird:face sleeping} {squirrel:face sleeping} ya estaban en la cama cuando {owl:live resume} Búho abrió un ojo… luego los dos, y ululó un gracias suave. {sfx:hoo} Uh-uh.

tweet.prompt: a small songbird singing a loud cheerful three-note chirp

hoo.prompt: a soft friendly owl hoot, two gentle notes, calm and warm
